title: Glossary of terms relating to oil burning appliances (pressure type and non pressure type
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard defines the terms relating to oil burning appliances, both pressure and non-pressure type, including wax candles. These appliances are generally used for cooking, heating and lighting.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Part 173 : 2020: Methods of Test for Petroleum and its Products [ P : 173 ] Determination of Lead Content in Motor Gasoline — Energy Dispersive X-Ray Fluorescence Spectrometry Method

clause_3_terminology: Glossary of terms relating to oil burning appliances
pressure type and non pressure type

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
